'''2013 Worlds Day 3 Kevin Shannon LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing (Virtual Block 7)|Communing]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
